question: Can my grocery shopping be cheaper?
title: Cheaper basket

cells.title: Find own-brand twins for her brands
cells.code:
s = shop.swaps(4)
um = kori.usual_month()
left_over = um["left_over"]
groceries = s["month_spend"]
eating_out = um["categories"].get("Restaurants", 0.0)
bigger = eating_out > groceries * 1.2

emit("saving_month", round(s["saving_month"], 2), "eur_per_month", "Saving a month with every swap")
emit("saving_year", round(s["saving_year"], 2), "eur", "Saving a year with every swap")
emit("swaps", s["swaps"], "count", "Brand products with an own-brand twin")
emit("month_spend", round(groceries, 2), "eur_per_month", "Groceries in a usual month")
emit("left_over", round(left_over, 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month leaves")
emit("left_over_with", round(left_over + s["saving_month"], 2), "eur_per_month", "A usual month leaves with every swap")
emit("eating_out_month", round(eating_out, 2), "eur_per_month", "Eating out in a usual month")
table("swaps", s["rows"], "Own-brand swaps")
emit("eating_out_bigger", 1 if bigger else 0, "count", "A bigger cost than groceries")

if s["swaps"] > 0:                       # nothing to swap: no kept answer, the question is worked out fresh
    text = f"Based on sample receipts, {s['swaps']} of your brand products have an own-brand twin: **{eur(s['saving_month'])}** less a month, {eur(s['saving_year'])} a year."
    if bigger:
        text += f" Your bigger lever is eating out, though: {eur(eating_out)} in a usual month against {eur(groceries)} for groceries."
    say(text)
